title: Discovery of novel thiazolylhydrazone derivatives as potent anti-cancer agents inducing ferroptosis via direct NRF2 inhibition.
authors: Meng, Xiaolu; Xu, Tianqi; Xu, Lunan; Du, Yixiang; Huo, Fan; Jin, Anchang; Li, Yajin; Yan, Chao; Zhang, Yaliang; Huang, Tengfei
one_liner_zh: 该文研究噻唑腙衍生物通过直接抑制NRF2诱导铁死亡抗癌，虽涉及TF（NRF2）与配体小分子对接，但对象为蛋白-小分子而非蛋白-DNA互作，方法仅分子对接且无TF-DNA结合建模，与本课题关联较弱。
abstract: Nuclear factor erythroid 2-related factor 2 (NRF2/NFE2L2) is a key transcription factor regulating antioxidant defense and iron metabolism. Its activation confers ferroptosis resistance to cancer cells and promotes tumor progression. In this study, we designed and synthesized a novel series of thiazolylhydrazone derivatives (1a-1g, 2a-2e, and 3a-3i) as NRF2 inhibitors and evaluated their antiproliferative activities against a panel of cancer cell lines. Among them, PhcY emerged as the most potent compound. Molecular docking studies demonstrated its strong binding affinity to the NRF2 active site, indicating direct inhibition. PhcY induced ferroptosis in MCF-7 breast cancer cells via NRF2 inhibition. Mechanistic investigations revealed that PhcY disrupted cellular iron homeostasis, facilitated ferritin degradation, and ultimately triggered ferroptosis. In vivo, PhcY demonstrated significant antitumor efficacy in MCF-7 xenograft-bearing mice at a dose of 10 mg/kg. These findings highlight the potential of thiazolylhydrazone derivatives, particularly PhcY, as NRF2-targeted ferroptosis inducers for cancer therapy.
abstract_zh: 核因子E2相关因子2（NRF2/NFE2L2）是调控抗氧化防御和铁代谢的关键转录因子。其激活赋予癌细胞铁死亡抗性，并促进肿瘤进展。在本研究中，我们设计并合成了一系列新型噻唑腙衍生物（1a-1g、2a-2e和3a-3i）作为NRF2抑制剂，并评估了它们对一组癌细胞系的抗增殖活性。其中，PhcY成为最有效的化合物。分子对接研究表明，其与NRF2活性位点具有强结合亲和力，表明存在直接抑制作用。PhcY通过抑制NRF2诱导MCF-7乳腺癌细胞发生铁死亡。机制研究揭示，PhcY破坏了细胞铁稳态，促进铁蛋白降解，并最终触发铁死亡。在体内，PhcY在10 mg/kg剂量下对MCF-7异种移植小鼠显示出显著的抗肿瘤疗效。这些发现凸显了噻唑腙衍生物（尤其是PhcY）作为靶向NRF2的铁死亡诱导剂在癌症治疗中的潜力。
